# Gideon Duckett & Hugh Carrow

- [Gideon Duckett](../character/gideon-duckett.md) — Comrade of — [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) — traveling companions rushing together to Grey Shutters · since v2  <sub>[v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) recounts her and Isolde's day of soliciting donations throughout [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) to [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), describing helpful and unhelpful encounters alike. She takes advantage of Lorenzo White's excitement over his new baby boy to secure a large donation. Finally, she attempts to get a contribution from Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), who turns her down.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P34](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0034), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P44](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0044), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) debate Mrs. Sowerby's character and discuss the Improvement Society's progress on fixing up the hall. Later, Mrs. Sowerby and the youths discover that [Joshua Tulk](../character/joshua-tulk.md) painted the hall bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with paint order numbers. Despite the catastrophic outcome, the community rallies behind the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and blames the [Tulks](../codex/factions.md#tulks) for the mistake.
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_

> Mrs. Sowerby chats with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about church bazaar plans before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes home to discuss family letters with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and handle Robin's comedic mischief. Later, at a B.V.I.S. meeting, [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md) reveals that [Judson Tibbs](../character/judson-tibbs.md) plans to rent his farm fence for commercial ads, sparking panic among the members.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P0](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0000), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P12](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0012), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P18](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0018), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035)_

> The Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) worries about [Judson Tibbs](../character/judson-tibbs.md) leasing his fences for medicine advertisements. A delegation consisting of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, and [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) meets with Judson, but he refuses to change his mind. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally overhears Judson accepting a political bribe from [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md), prompting Judson to drop the advertising plan to keep her silent.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P49](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0049), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh attend a farewell gathering hosted by the B.V.I.S., where they receive send-off gifts. After feeling discouraged by local opinions about her upcoming college attendance, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes for a walk through the woods with Hugh, finding a wild apple tree and enjoying a quiet walk home along [Linger Lane](../codex/places.md#linger-lane).
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P5](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0005), [v3 ch.Autumn P11](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0011), [v3 ch.Autumn P31](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0031)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) settle into college life at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), aided by Cressida Lindsay's social influence while [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) earns respect as Freshman Class president. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a stack of letters from home containing updates from [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and news from her friends and family, including humorous local stories from Mrs. Sowerby.
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007), [v3 ch.Home P10](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0010)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) helps Isolde dress and prepare for her wedding day at [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill). Following the ceremony and celebration, Hugh accompanies [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on a evening stroll back toward [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), taking a detour down Lovers' Lane to chat about their lives.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIX Isolde’s Wedding

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P1](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0001), [v3 ch.Wedding P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013), [v3 ch.Wedding P17](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0017)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) feeling melancholic about her broken engagement and lost youth. She visits neighbors and friends, learning about recent local developments, wedding announcements, and births, which heightens her sense of loneliness.
>
